intendedUse: Local noncommercial image-model research for head/arms/torso through hips. Actual bounded preflight steps and evaluation are recorded separately; no model has been promoted to the game.

scope.hands: Separate 21-landmark hand localization; body-only datasets cannot supervise finger joints.
scope.missingAnnotationPolicy: Mask missing labels; head top is not relabelled as nose; no invented leg/world-depth ground truth.

datasets.annotationSchema: 17 body points with visibility; use first 13 upper-body joints

rights.images: Individual Flickr licenses; acquisition/training must retain image/source/license records and select attribution-only CC-BY image licenses.

access.images: Official COCO image URLs from annotations; HTTPS endpoint failed during this inspection, HTTP endpoint available.

localAnnotations.note: SHA records actual acquired bytes; no publisher-provided checksum was found. Local research only.

datasets.acquiredScope: 8503 explicit CC-BY eligible photos; 20121 train people / 8131 images and 919 validation people / 372 images. Not all COCO2017.

datasets.annotationSchema: 16 body joints, head rectangle and visibility. Eight arm/hip joints map directly; face/nose labels absent.

rights.scope: Official download page permits research and prohibits commercial use; code/annotations described as Simplified BSD. Images' underlying copyrights are not owned by dataset authors.
rights.publicationPolicy: Keep data/checkpoints local research artifacts; no production model or image redistribution assumed.

rights.scope: Publisher README states research/noncommercial only while also naming CC-BY-4.0 annotations. Do not infer production permission from the CC label alone.

publishedSize.sizeBasis: Published comparison in COCO-WholeBody official README; not a local count.

rights.scope: No explicit dataset license grant found in official README/repository root. HICO-DET train images and COCO validation images have separate rights; code licenses do not supply a data grant.
No explicit dataset license grant found in official README. Images overlap COCO/MPII/AIC source pools; deduplicate and inherit/check original rights before use.

datasets.annotationSchema: 14 body points and person boxes; head/arms/hips, no fingers

rights.scope: The author paper documents the dataset; the inspected official repository does not supply a current explicit data license/access grant.

datasets.annotationSchema: 2D,3D,normalized3D body poses with camera calibration; inspect official joint-order utility before conversion

rights.scope: Official metadata archive README restricts to scientific noncommercial research; bundled license also restricts methods/models to noncommercial use and prohibits redistribution.

localEnvironment.gpuTrainingStatus: No supported training stack verified. RX6600M absent from inspected official Windows ROCm matrix; do not claim GPU acceleration.

trainingPlan.architecture: Actual RGB image network: pretrained MobileNetV3-Small features plus 13-joint heatmap head; masked supervision across canonical common joints.
initialTrainingSources: mpii official noncommercial research train split
trainingPlan.evaluation: COCO official validation subset and a deterministic MPII video-group research holdout inside its official training partition. Check shared source-image hashes across splits; report declared arm/hip PCK, occlusion and failure counts. A bounded preflight is not completed dataset training.
trainingPlan.execution: CPU, bounded threads; benchmark actual steps before full run; no fabricated timing or accuracy.
trainingPlan.deployment: Export checkpoint to ONNX; verify PyTorch/ORT coordinates numerically, then browser WASM/WebGPU capability and live checks before replacing production tracker.
trainingPlan.mediaPipeLimitation: Official Model Maker customization table has no pose/hand landmark training path. GestureRecognizer customization trains a category classifier on detected landmarks, not an arm-localization model.

statusMeaning.downloaded: All images in the explicitly selected eligible image index, not the entire named source benchmark; annotation/archive availability is recorded separately.
statusMeaning.trained: Completed full eligible-dataset training. Bounded real-data preflight steps do not set this flag.
